A.notes: Site A introduces a clever conceptual idea with the global sun tracker, but the execution falls slightly flat. The project illustrations are a bit basic and don't feel deeply integrated into the lighting concept. The overall layout and typography are clean and functional, but lack a strong architectural signature.

B.notes: Site B delivers a stunning interpretation of the brief. The scroll-driven brick wall reveals perfectly embody the themes of light and courtyard enclosures, and the graceful typography gives the studio a highly refined identity. The reduced-motion fallback intelligently leaves all the walls 'open', ensuring a seamless experience without the animation.

raw.why: Site B takes a brilliant core concept—brick walls opening to reveal light and space—and executes it flawlessly across motion, typography, and illustration.
